Method of Attack: Remote code execution via StringLookup using untrusted values to resolve DNS records, load values from URLs, and execute scripts using a JVM script execution engine
Impacted Systems: Systems using Apache Commons Text library versions 1.5.x through 1.9.x
Attack Vector: StringLookup expressions resolving DNS records, loading values from URLs, and executing scripts from remote sources
Indicators of Compromise: Untrusted URLs and scripts used in StringLookup
